title: Do you want one list of open questions sent to Paul?
bluf: 23 tickets wait on HP, Paul, or an HP tool (answers, access, or HP-tool integration, which this phase does not build). Rather than 23 cards, Tuesday can prepare one list for Paul with a line per ticket. You send it; nobody else messages Paul. Default if you do not tap: option B, no list, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10).
